_doc: Leithanien (Leytaniya) bond summons for the Garrison Protocol / Weishu autochess mode. Static unit stats are factual numbers transcribed from the PRTS wiki unit pages (the summons are modeled in-game as enemy-type units SP32/SP33, so they carry an enemy attribute table). Only numeric facts and short mechanic paraphrases are stored; no prose is copied. License of the source wiki applies to its presentation, not to these game facts.
